  "repair_strategy": "Update the FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS selector in lib/src/index.js to exclude elements that are visually hidden (display:none, visibility:hidden, aria-hidden=true) or have zero size. This ensures only visible, interactive elements participate in the focus trap.",

    'a[href]',
    'area[href]',
    'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"]):not([aria-hidden])',

    'textarea:not([disabled]):not([aria-hidden])',

    "Elements with aria-hidden="true" but visually shown may be excluded from focus order",
    "CSS display:none on focusable elements now correctly removes them from focus trap"

  "verification_requirements": [
    "Tab from #upload wraps to #modal-close (not #help)",
